text: Over 450 million US dollars is lost every year due to faulty
procurement means. Through Quorum, we seek to address this challenge.
Let me show you how it works.
We start on the supplier side.

to be submitted.

the requested requirement.

to compare. That gives the reviewer a useful starting point.

requirements through to bid opening and evaluation.
The criteria are set before the bids are assessed.
